rooms.name: The Gridlock
rooms.description: Stuck on Jalan Tun Razak — the incident begins
rooms.unlock_text: Traffic hasn't moved in 20 minutes. Your phone lights up red.

rooms.name: Requirements Tollbooth
rooms.description: Define your fix to proceed — or take the express LRT lane
rooms.unlock_text: You open your laptop. A toll plaza blocks the road ahead.

rooms.name: The Mamak
rooms.description: Optional roadside stop — teh tarik, stories, and bonus intel
rooms.unlock_text: Pak Ali waves you over to his mamak for a quick teh tarik.

rooms.name: Architecture Overpass
rooms.description: Manual navigation — design every component yourself
rooms.unlock_text: The toll sign turns green. A wide overpass rises ahead.

rooms.name: The Log Jam
rooms.description: Manual navigation — trace the crash timeline by hand
rooms.unlock_text: Traffic stops dead. The crash logs scatter across your screen.

rooms.name: The Express Lane
rooms.description: AI Navigator (AIDLC) — Kiro proposes, you decide
rooms.unlock_text: The LRT gate opens onto empty, fast asphalt.

rooms.name: Construction Lane
rooms.description: Both paths converge — validate the spec and build
rooms.unlock_text: Cranes and cones. Your coding terminal waits on a makeshift desk.

rooms.name: Verification Checkpoint
rooms.description: Dual-loop sensors, reviewer, and the final human gate
rooms.unlock_text: Scanners and blinking lights block the lane ahead.

rooms.name: The Learning Loop
rooms.description: Teach the system — each decision becomes a rule
rooms.unlock_text: The fix is live — but Kiro wants to learn from your calls.

rooms.name: Deployment Terminal
rooms.description: The finish line — ship it to production
rooms.unlock_text: GoLancar HQ. The map is waiting to light back up.
